british-overseas-territories.title: Flag of the British Overseas Territories

colors.note: British Blue Ensign for overseas territories.

desc:
- A Blue Ensign defaced with the British Overseas Territories crest
- Used collectively to represent all 14 British Overseas Territories
- **Construction:** a Blue Ensign (1:2) with the Union Flag in the upper-hoist canton. The collective BOT crest appears in the fly half
trivia:
- Fourteen British Overseas Territories maintain Union Jack flags
- These territories represent remnants of the British Empire scattered across the globe
- Each has varying degrees of autonomy and representation
